# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We aim to make participation in this project respectful and constructive for
people with different backgrounds and levels of experience.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful, specific, and constructive.
- Discuss technical ideas and evidence; do not attack people.
- Accept good-faith corrections and differing viewpoints.
- Respect privacy. Do not publish another person's credentials, personal
  information, private conversations, or unredacted diagnostic logs.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, personal attacks, deliberate
 disclosure of private information, and sustained disruptive conduct are not
acceptable.

## Enforcement

Report conduct that violates this policy privately to the repository owner
using the contact details on the GitHub profile. Reports will be reviewed in
good faith and handled as confidentially as practical. The maintainer may edit
or remove content, close discussions, or restrict participation when needed
to protect the community. Best-effort enforcement is provided while the project
has a single maintainer.

This policy is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1.
